title: An operator and its transpose
promptMarkdown: Using valid cross-correlation, x=(2,−1,3,4) and w=(1,2), write the matrixC_w, calculatey and compute the gradient of L=g·y for g=(1,−2,3) with respect to x andw. Explain why C_wᵀ is not the inverse ofC_w and check the identityg·(C_wx)=(C_wᵀg)·x.
hintLadder: Arrange one shifted kernel per output row.
Check the dimensions and nullspace before saying “inverse”.
